newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SUKOVA AND MAJOLI REACH LEIPZIG SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SUKOVA AND MAJOLI REACH LEIPZIG SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Unseeded Helena Sukova scored an upset victory over second seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario on Friday, beating the Spaniard 6-3 7-6 in the Leipzig tournament quarter-finals.
The Czech now faces a semifinal match with Iva Majoli of Croatia, who scraped through 6-7 7-6 7-6 against America's Lindsay Davenport in Friday's other quarter final.
But the main draw for the home crowd will be the other semifinal, an all-German duel between Anke Huber and world number one Steffi Graf.
"Of course Steffi is the favourite," said Huber, the fourth seed. "But that doesn't mean the outcome of the game is a foregone conclusion. I think I have a good chance of winning."
Sanchez seemed to have difficulty concentrating on her game while Sukova produced excellent serves and volleys to secure her straight-sets win.
Davenport and Majoli battled for two hours in a titanic tussle for the remaining semifinal berth, with the Croat holding her nerve to clinch the match with a 7-3 victory in the final set tiebreak.
